tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Excess ITC reversal showing in GSTR-09 as compared to the GSTR-3B for Rs 2092/-. Analysis of Table 9C of GSTR-1 filed for the FY 2020-21 revealed that we have increased the taxable value of invoices reported earlier through issuance of debit notes. Thus, we hereby liable to pay interest on the increased tax value reported in those invoices as per section 50(1) of TNGST/CGST Act,2017 of Rs 1,05,544/- and Penalty of Rs 20,000/-. Total Demand is for Rs 1,27,636/- out of which we already paid Rs.2092/- and we filed appeal for reversal of Interest and penalty amount of Rs. 1,25,544/-
tax_litigation.status: Appeal filed by AAL 23.05.2025 . Waiting for the authorities’ response. PH called for 21.01.26.
